2608.14312.title: Envs-FORGE: Frontier-Optimized Reward-Grounded Environment Synthesis for Agent RL
2608.14312.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for terminal agents needs executable training environments with reliable rewards and useful difficulty. Fixed recipes such as few-shot, Self-Instruct, and Evol-Instruct apply the same prompting policy to every seed, even when the current policy would benefit from a harder, easier, or simply different task. We present Envs-FORGE, a prompting policy that converts verifier rewards into per-seed environment-synthesis actions. Envs-FORGE estimates seed pass rates, scores six projection--direction actions around a target learning frontier, and solves a per-seed mixed-integer linear program (MILP) to choose the action that conditions generation. The selected action drives synchronized rewriting of the instruction, fixtures, oracle solution, tests, and Docker environment; only gold-verified bundles enter RL training. The indexed MILP form also supports optional soft skill coverage for portfolio planning. On Qwen 3.5 35B, Envs-FORGE improves Pass@1 over Base by 9.2 percentage points on tb-core (40.0% to 49.2%) and 6.4 points on tb-2.0 (23.0% to 29.4%), exceeding the strongest fixed-recipe baseline by 2.4 and 2.1 points. It reaches 77.1% on SWE-bench Verified versus 73.4% for Base, and improves tb-core by 6.8--9.2 points across the evaluated 4B--35B models. All synthesis methods export 100 verified environments and use 2.27M--2.88M synthesis tokens, placing the comparison at the same downstream training-set size and the same operational scale. The source code is available at https://github.com/DataArcTech/DataArc-SynData-Toolkit/.
2608.14312.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習（RL）對於終端代理需要可執行的訓練環境，並具備可靠的獎勵和有用的難度。固定的配方，如少量樣本、自我指導和進化指導，對每個種子應用相同的提示策略，即使當前策略會從更難、更簡單或僅僅是不同的任務中受益。我們提出了 Envs-FORGE，一種將驗證者獎勵轉換為每個種子環境合成行動的提示策略。Envs-FORGE 估計種子的通過率，圍繞目標學習邊界評分六個投影方向行動，並解決每個種子的混合整數線性規劃（MILP），以選擇條件生成的行動。所選行動驅動指令、固定裝置、預言者解決方案、測試和 Docker 環境的同步重寫；只有經過金標驗證的包才能進入 RL 訓練。索引的 MILP 形式還支持投資組合規劃的可選軟技能覆蓋。在 Qwen 3.5 35B 上，Envs-FORGE 在 tb-core 上將 Pass@1 提高了 9.2 個百分點（從 40.0% 提升至 49.2%），在 tb-2.0 上提高了 6.4 個百分點（從 23.0% 提升至 29.4%），超過最強的固定配方基準 2.4 和 2.1 個百分點。在 SWE-bench Verified 上達到 77.1%，而 Base 為 73.4%，並在評估的 4B--35B 模型中改善了 tb-core 6.8--9.2 個百分點。所有合成方法輸出 100 個經驗證的環境，並使用 2.27M--2.88M 的合成標記，使比較在相同的下游訓練集大小和相同的操作規模下進行。源代碼可在 https://github.com/DataArcTech/DataArc-SynData-Toolkit/ 獲得。
